title: Paramount Skydance Rises 4% on 12-State Settlement, Warner Bros. Discovery Holds Flat as $110B Deal Nears Its Close
title_zh: Paramount Skydance Rises 4% on 12-State Settlement, Warner Bros. Discovery Holds Flat as $110B Deal Nears Its Close
